WHY NOT a switching fixture: a spec's IMPORTS should say which set it tests. A `pages` fixture that resolves by project name means reading the Playwright config to know what a spec covers, and it makes a cross-set spec (pp-065's co-residency spec, which needs BOTH) impossible to express. Playwright fixtures are lazy — declaring both costs nothing at runtime for a spec that uses one.

notes:
THE TESTS REPO IS A SEPARATE GIT REPO with its own remote, branches and CI (`.github/workflows/`). Its npm scripts are its own — there is no frontend `test:features` / `lint:arch` here. Verbatim from package.json this session: "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"; "lint": "eslint ."; "format:check": "prettier --check '**/*.{ts,js,mjs,md,json,yml,yaml}'"; "test": "npm run _assert_stack && npm run _clean && npm run database:reseed && npm run _test_e2e"; "test:local": "npm run test:integration"; "test:a11y": "npm run _clean_and_test -- --grep '@a11y'"; "test:cross-browser"; "test:docker-compose".

TAKE THE 'BEFORE' LIST FIRST. The acceptance bar is an identical test count, so capture `playwright test --list` BEFORE touching anything (it is the first verification command for that reason) and diff it at the end. A silent count drop from a `testMatch` that misses a subtree is the single most likely defect in this increment and it is invisible in a green run.

PURE MOVE DISCIPLINE. Use `git mv` so history follows the files, and change NOTHING inside a moved file except its import paths and its fixture destructuring. If you find yourself improving a page object while moving it, stop — that is a different increment and it destroys the 'identical test count, identical assertions' proof.

WHY MOVE LIVE-ANIMALS AT ALL (R7): the same argument as the mount scheme. An incumbent set sitting at the root while the newcomer sits in a named subdir is a permanent special case in every future planner's head. One fact per set, symmetric everywhere. Sam accepted the churn explicitly.

THE TWO CONFIG TRAPS, both verified live and neither in §10.6:
1. `utils/playwright/with-project-base-urls.ts:3-6` has a HARDCODED project-name → env-var map, and `:39-43` throws for any project missing from the passed `projectBaseUrls`. Renaming a project without updating both places fails either at config load (loud, fine) or at first navigation with `TRADE_IMPORTS_ANIMALS_FRONTEND_BASE_URL is not set` (confusing).
2. `playwright.e2e.config.ts:25-38` and `playwright.cross-browser.config.ts:17-36` REPLACE `projects` wholesale rather than inheriting shared-config's. Editing only shared-config.ts leaves the workspace E2E lane and the cross-browser lane running the old shape.

SET-NEUTRAL SPECS: decided here so pp-065 does not have to reopen it — a spec that exercises BOTH sets (co-residency) lives at `tests/e2e/features/*.spec.ts` with no set dir, and is matched by the live-animals project. Both sets share one server and one base URL, so the project is a selector, not an environment.

SCOPE FENCE: no plant-products page object, flow, spec or seed lands here. Empty per-set dirs are created only where a later increment fills them immediately; do not commit placeholder files that a reader will mistake for coverage.

ROLLBACK: `git stash push -u`, never `reset --hard` + `clean -fd`.
